name: Kisaragi Ryouji
source: A modern kid who doesn't care much about things. He works at his own pace and likes Japanese sweets and games. Although he is not the type to stand out and has lived a quiet student life up until now, he is a talented person who is surprisingly suited to cross-dressing.
